```sql
GROUP BY

  o_orderstatus
```

SELECT
    r.r_name,
    COUNT(*) AS supplier_count,
    SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.s_acctbal < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_count
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
GROUP BY r.r_name
ORDER BY r.r_name

    ```sql
        n.n_name,
        COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count

        orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey

    ORDER BY

        n_name ASC;
    ```

    FROM lineitem l

    c_mktsegment,

FROM repeat_pairs
GROUP BY c_mktsegment

SELECT
    split_part(p.p_type, ' ', 1) AS family,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
    SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS cost,
    (SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) - SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity)) / SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS margin
FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01'
GROUP BY split_part(p.p_type, ' ', 1)
ORDER BY margin DESC

    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS late_pct

    lineitem l

    supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN
    nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey

    region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    late_pct DESC

WITH nation_avg AS (
    SELECT
        n_nationkey,
        AVG(c_acctbal) AS nation_avg_acctbal
    FROM customer
    GROUP BY n_nationkey
)
SELECT
    n.n_name AS n_name,
    na.nation_avg_acctbal AS nation_avg_acctbal,
    COUNT(*) AS above_avg_count
FROM nation n
JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN nation_avg na ON n.n_nationkey = na.n_nationkey
WHERE c.c_acctbal > na.nation_avg_acctbal
GROUP BY n.n_name, na.nation_avg_acctbal
ORDER BY n.n_name

    ```sql
SELECT
    ```
    c_mktsegment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    SUM(c_acctbal) AS total_acctbal
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.c_mktsegment,
        c.c_acctbal,
        c.c_custkey
    FROM customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM orders o2
        WHERE o2.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
          AND o2.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'
    )
    GROUP BY
        c.c_mktsegment,
        c.c_acctbal,
        c.c_custkey
)
GROUP BY
    c_mktsegment
ORDER BY
    c_mktsegment

           ```sql
    COUNT(DISTINCT c_custkey) AS customer_count,
           ```
    COUNT(*) AS pair_count
            ```sql
FROM (
            ```
```sql
    SELECT
        c.c_custkey,
        c.c_mktsegment,
        l.l_partkey
```
    FROM
        customer c
    JOIN
        ```sql
        orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
        ```

        lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    GROUP BY
        c.c_custkey, l.l_partkey, c.c_mktsegment

        COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) >= 2
